Record Class AgenticSeed

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.shaft.ai.agentic.AgenticSeed
Record Components:
journeyId - stable journey identifier
journeyText - user journey description
pageContent - untrusted page content captured for the fixture (may be empty)
seedHash - SHA-256 of the canonical seed material
public record AgenticSeed(String journeyId, String journeyText, String pageContent, String seedHash) extends Record
Deterministic seed state bound to every phase (FR-2).
